_about: PARKED. Wave 1 of ../m0-rich.md: the Anti-hero's 38 key strikes as specs Animation can pose from. Not loaded, not hashed. classes, uses and ground are copied from moveset.antihero.m0.json. range.lunge, range.reach and range.clear are Animation's measurements of the posed strikes (art/animation/review/wave1/reach-table.md). Working labels throughout.
shapeLanguage: blades: at contact the striking limb and the opposite limb make one long straight line through the body; joints are sharp angles; the torso stays narrow and side-on; hands are open blades or claws unless the look says a fist; one dominant diagonal per pose, readable at 40 px. From the crouch he strikes upward and outward; from Regalia he stands taller and the lines lengthen.
legal: no moment shows more than two of the seven marks (rule-of-cool.md section 1, rule 9): no chamber holds clenched fists at his sides in the crouch
no franchise poses: see _legal on single pieces
every authored pose keeps its _orig line and provenance record

reachTable._source: the limb-and-socket envelope from pose-pipeline.md 9.13: kept for the unposed tail rows only; posed strikes carry their own measurements

range.rule: offset = the smaller of 58 and lunge, and never under clear: the blow lands on the hips' lunge alone and no other part of him passes into the rival
range.lunge: the farthest distance the blow lands at on the hips' lunge alone
range.reach: the farthest with the whole-body step-in as well
range.clear: the nearest distance at which nothing but the striking limb touches the rival
range.long: 56 u and over: hand to head or chest
range.mid: 44 to 55 u: hand to gut, every kick
range.close: under 44 u: elbow, knee, head, shoulder
range._clinch: proposed floor for a strike's own step-in; moves that are not a strike's step-in keep contact.minSeparation (45)

ticks._about: load is the piece's shortest anticipation; the template's wind-up stretches it (opener 15 light or 20 heavy, ender 18, mid and return 6). follow is the hold after contact; recover overlaps the next piece's load in a string.

pose.derive: Animation's existing family covers it with the limb and target tags
pose.contact: a silhouette of its own: one contact pose
pose.held: not posed until Orb rules on the tail

brokenArm: a piece with uses.arms 1 plays on the good arm (the mirror)
never two arm strikes back to back
brokenLeg: in the air a piece with uses.legs 1 plays on the good leg
on the ground drop every piece whose ground is plant or only
never two leg strikes back to back
filter.side: the broken side comes from the sim's wounds state (spec-wounds.md 1d), not from a hash
tests: no blow uses a broken limb, over 200 forced matches per break
no key strike twice in one string of up to 8 blows
in the worst case (a broken leg, on the ground) 12 lights and 10 heavies stay
three-strike series repeat in under 10% of strings in forced broken-limb matches

strikes.look: A straight blade hand from the lead shoulder, the arm one line with the rear leg; the body barely turns.
The rear hand driven straight through the chest, hips turned full, the lead forearm guard folded across the ribs.
A flat, tight arc at head height, the elbow a sharp right angle, the plated forearm leading the hand.
The arm unfolds backhanded to full length, the back of the hand leading, chest opened away from the rival.

strikes._legal: the hand stays open, flat or clawed, never cupped; never a hand chambered at the hip for an energy release afterwards
strikes.look: A clawed open palm pushed straight in from the ribs, fingers spread like tines, the wrist bent back.
A low blade-hand thrust from the crouch into the gut, the spine and the arm one long diagonal.

strikes._legal: no leap and no spin: not a jumping, turning uppercut; no fist held up after it as a victory pose
strikes.look: A closed fist rising under the chin; the rise is in the hip and shoulder, the feet stay where they are, the other arm low across the body.
The fist comes straight down from above the head like a dropped blade, the body folding over it.
A looping blow over the rival's guard, the shoulder rolled high, the head ducked off the line.
The widest swing he has: the arm nearly straight, the whole torso thrown round behind it.
The forearm folded shut and the point of the elbow cut across under the jaw: a small, sharp triangle.
The elbow driven up the centre line under the jaw, the hand ending behind his own ear, the plate edge leading.

strikes._legal: a single turn; no travelling or multi-hit spin
strikes.look: One turn with his back shown, the elbow whipping through level at jaw height at the end of it.
From above: the point of the elbow dropped onto the chest, the other hand pinning the rival's guard down.
Both blade hands thrust side by side, a hand apart, elbows locked: two parallel lines.

strikes._legal: a melee strike only: no light, glow or beam leaves the hands, no shouted name, no pause with the palms forward after it; never wrists together, and never chambered as cupped hands at one hip
strikes.look: Both clawed palms shoved in at shoulder width, fingers up, elbows flared wide.

strikes._legal: not a two-fisted clasped overhead smash
strikes.look: Both forearm guards brought down side by side like a dropped bar; the hands are apart and open.

strikes._legal: a strike in motion, never a held crossed-arms power pose
strikes.look: The forearm guards crossed into a wedge and driven in behind the shoulders, head tucked behind the plates.
A straight push with the ball of the foot from a high knee, the body leaning back off the line.
Turned fully side-on, the leg and the opposite arm one horizontal line, the heel leading.
A short chop of the shin into the thigh, his own body upright and still.
A quick whip from the knee, the hips barely turned, the foot back before the rival moves.
The full turn of the hips, the leg a long blade through the ribs, the arms thrown back the other way.
The leg lifted straight and brought down heel first onto the collar, his body a vertical line beside it.

strikes._legal: a single turn; no travelling or multi-hit spin
strikes.look: One turn with his back shown, the heel coming round at the end of a straight leg.
The knee drawn to his chest and the sole driven straight down; his arms spread for balance.
Dropped onto one hand, the other leg scything flat along the ground.
Both feet together with the body laid flat behind them, arms back along his sides.
A short knee from the clinch, one hand on the rival's shoulder, the standing leg straight.
The knee driven up as he rises onto the toes, hips thrust through, both hands pulling down.
A knee carried in on the end of a run, the body leaning back, the trailing leg straight behind.
The masked brow driven into the jaw from the waist, hands holding the rival's arms down.
A short step and the plated shoulder into the chest, chin tucked behind it, arms close.

strikes._legal: a hair, cloth or metal tail, never a furred or reptilian one
strikes.look: The tail whips straight past his hip like a thrown line; his hands never move.

strikes.look: A low flat arc of the tail under the rival's legs while he stands upright.

strikes._legal: a hair, cloth or metal tail, never a furred or reptilian one
strikes.look: He turns his back and the tail comes round as one driven lash at chest height.
